items.description:
This is intended to be a curation of resources for the new among the software testing community. It is not tailored to a specific area (Usability/Performance) or role (Automation/Management). The idea is that you could hand this list to a CS graduate and it would greatly improve their testing skills, efficiency and overall breadth of knowledge. Note that this is for all areas of software testing after the code in question is written (no unit tests/static analysis!).
Finally, I'm sure everyone who reads this list has one thing they want to add. Please read the How to Contribute page and add to the list. :)
items.title: Foreword
Bruno
items.description: Open-source API client for exploring and testing APIs.

items.title: Keploy
items.description: API Testing Platform that automatically generates unit test cases along with dependency mocks.

items.title: RestQA
items.description: REST API testing framework based on Gherkin.

items.title: Swagger Coverage Tool
items.description: The Swagger Coverage Tool is designed to measure API test coverage based on Swagger documentation. It provides automated tracking and reporting of test coverage for APIs, helping ensure that your endpoints and services are well-tested.

items.title: SpecTest
items.description: Truly declarative API testing framework in Js, or plain JSON.

items.title: postman2pytest
items.description: Convert a Postman Collection v2.1 JSON file into a ready-to-run pytest test suite.

items.title: Webhook Debugger
items.description: Open-source, self-hosted webhook inspector with signature verification support.

items.title: Tests Coverage Tool
items.description: Ultimate tool to measure gRPC service coverage from tests.

items.title: Nuclei Scanner
items.description: nuclie is automated scanner for common vulnerbilty finding on site.

items.title: OWASP ZAP
items.description: Intercepting proxy for HTTP traffic manipulation, security scanning, and exploitation.

items.title: promptfoo
items.description: Open-source framework for testing and red teaming LLM applications. Compare prompts, test RAG architectures, run multi-turn adversarial attacks, and catch security vulnerabilities with CI/CD integration.

items.title: nika
items.description: Workflow engine for AI with testing built in: pins a workflow's offline behavior as a golden snapshot (deterministic mock provider, zero keys) and replays it in CI; every run also leaves a hash-chained trace for post-hoc verification.

items.title: voicetest
items.description: Open-source test harness for voice AI agents supporting Retell, VAPI, LiveKit, and Bland with autonomous simulations and LLM-based evaluation.

items.title: Evaliphy
items.description: Test your AI system end-to-end with Evaliphy. It uses a Playwright-style testing approach and generates HTML reports.

items.title: Tenro
items.description: Open-source testing framework for AI agents. Simulate LLM and tool calls to test edge cases, failure paths, and agent logic without live API calls.

items.title: AgentSkeptic
items.description: Verifies AI/agent workflows by checking database state after execution, comparing expected vs observed outcomes with read-only SQL.

items.title: WireMock
items.description: Open source HTTP mock engine written in Java. Embed in your test code, run as a standalone process, or deploy via Docker.

items.title: MockServer
items.description: Mocking, debugging proxy and chaos engineering tool for multiple protocols (HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, LLM, MCP, Kafka, TCP and more); mock any dependency, record/replay and inspect traffic, verify requests, and inject faults. Docker, JAR, Helm, multi-language clients.

items.title: DeepfakeHTTP
items.description: Web server using HTTP dumps as a response source for API simulation.

items.title: fakecloud
items.description: Free, open-source local AWS cloud emulator for integration tests, with 23 services at 100% conformance and first-party test-assertion SDKs in 6 languages.

items.title: mockd
items.description: Open-source multi-protocol mock server supporting HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, MQTT, and SOAP with chaos engineering and proxy recording.

items.title: recheck-web
items.description: Change comparison tool with Golden Masters and "unbreakable Selenium" tests.

items.title: Sherlo
items.description: Visual testing platform for React Native Storybook. Captures screenshots on iOS and Android simulators in the cloud and detects visual changes automatically.

items.title: GoodLooks
items.description: AI-powered visual validation for Playwright tests.

items.title: Frostbyte Screenshot Action
items.description: GitHub Action for automated website screenshots in CI/CD pipelines. Supports multiple viewports, full-page capture, and dark mode emulation.

items.title: QA Wolf
items.description: Node.js library for creating browser tests faster.

items.title: Ferrum
items.description: Chrome automation via CDP with a high-level Ruby API.

items.title: Hercules
items.description: Open-source end-to-end testing agent.

items.title: playwright-bdd
items.description: BDD-style Playwright testing.

items.title: agent-qa
items.description: Open-source Agentic QA Harness with Memory. Write tests in natural language. agent-qa runs them across web and mobile with execution memory, catching regressions before release.

items.title: tapflow
items.description: Self-hosted mobile QA tool that streams iOS simulators and Android emulators to the browser for team-wide testing without local setup.

items.title: flutter-skill
items.description: AI-powered E2E testing via MCP for Flutter, React Native, iOS, Android, Electron, Tauri, KMP, and .NET MAUI. Zero test code.

items.title: UI Coverage Tool
items.description: UI Coverage Tool is an innovative, no-overhead solution for tracking and visualizing UI test coverage — directly on your actual application, not static snapshots.

items.title: TestLink
items.description: Open-source test case management system.

items.title: Kiwi TCMS
items.description: Open-source test case management.

items.title: skipper
items.description: Real-time test execution control via Google Spreadsheet, enabling instant toggle without code changes.

items.title: Synth
items.description: Open-source test data generator.

items.title: Touca
items.description: Continuous regression testing for behavioral and performance comparisons.

items.title: test-each
items.description: Data-driven testing framework.

items.title: DATAMIMIC CE
items.description: Open-source, deterministic engine for model-driven synthetic test data and PII pseudonymization. Pin a seed and get byte-identical output with a provenance hash on every run. Python, MIT.

items.title: MockJutsu
items.description: Algorithmic open-source mock data engine generating 390+ format-valid types (IBAN, TCKN, Luhn, VIN, NHS, SWIFT, MRZ and more). CLI + REST API + Python package + JMeter plugin. 6 locales.

items.title: JSON Validation Test Cases
items.description: Reusable valid, invalid, and edge-case JSON fixtures for testing parsers, validators, APIs, editors, and error handling.

items.title: Foundry
items.description: Fast, modular toolkit for Ethereum development.

items.title: Robot Framework Solidity Testing Toolkit
items.description: Robot Framework integration for Solidity testing.

items.title: Jumpstarter
items.description: Open source hardware-in-the-loop testing framework for automated testing on real and virtual hardware with CI/CD integration.

items.title: OpenTester
items.description: MCP-First Testing Framwork: AI Agents Can Now Test Like Humans

items.title: ai-natural-language-tests
items.description: Generates Cypress and Playwright E2E tests from natural language requirements using LangGraph, ChromaDB, and multi-provider LLM support.

items.title: rrweb

items.title: FrontRow
items.description: Open source React Native mobile app built as a hands on training surface for QA automation. Cross platform testIDs work across Maestro, Appium, Espresso and XCUITest, and a deep QA Debug Menu lets trainees force the failure modes that actually bite in production (4xx, 5xx, timeouts, offline, denied permissions, declined IAP, expired tokens) without flaky backends.
